name: 18944 · Perkasie, PA
findings: ZIP 18944 (Perkasie) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18944 (Perkasie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
